raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- In Kimi-K3 prefill on MI355X, the replicated BF16 latent MoE projections (down `[3584, 7168]`, up `[7168, 3584]`) run on every rank. At large batches they are a large, compute-bound cost.
- gfx950 runs MXFP4 GEMMs (AITER `gemm_a4w4`) much faster than BF16. Keeping an MXFP4 copy of these two weights cuts that cost, at the price of extra memory and lossy quantization.
- So this is opt-in and only for large batches. The default serving path does not change.

## Modifications

- `sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip`: a thin AITER adapter (`pack`, `run`) registered as `gemm.kimi_k3_latent_mxfp4` (HIP). It packs a BF16 weight to preshuffled MXFP4 with E8M0 scales, then runs per-1x32 activation quant plus `gemm_a4w4`.
- `kimi_k3_rocm_mxfp4.LatentMXFP4Projections` owns non-persistent packed buffers. They are built after weight loading and refilled in place on reload.
- `KimiK3MoE`: the fused and unfused paths use the MXFP4 down/up projections at or above the token threshold. Router and shared experts stay on their BF16 path; latent reduction, norm, and output combine are unchanged.
- Memory: the copies take about 2.34 GiB per GPU (92 latent MoE layers), which comes out of the KV cache budget. The docs say to recheck token capacity and `--mem-fraction-static`.
- Standalone on upstream `main` (`43728298fe`); no dependency on other PRs.

| Env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4` | `false` | Keep MXFP4 copies of the latent down/up projections and use them for large batches (lossy) |
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4_MIN_TOKENS` | `2048` | Smallest batch (tokens) that uses the MXFP4 copies; must be positive |

| Condition | Latent projections |
|---|---|
| Flag on, gfx950, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, BF16 `[3584, 7168]` / `[7168, 3584]` weights, no MoE a2a, batch >= `MIN_TOKENS` | MXFP4 `gemm_a4w4` |
| Batch < `MIN_TOKENS` | BF16, as before |
| `SGLANG_USE_AITER=0`, non-gfx950, or AITER missing | BF16; one warning |
| Quantized latent projections (GGUF / ExpertPack) or an MoE a2a backend | BF16; MXFP4 copies are not built |
| Unexpected weight shape or dtype | BF16; warning |

## Accuracy Tests

- Model: `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, 8x MI355X, TP8/DCP8 (the launch setup below).
- Eval: sgl-eval 0.1.3 (separate venv), full GSM8K (1,319), single shot, 1 repeat, 64 threads, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, reasoning_effort max, max_tokens 32768, seed 42.

| Metric | Flag off | Flag on, MIN_TOKENS 2048 |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K correct | 1285/1319 | 1286/1319 |
| Score | 97.42% | 97.50% |
| Request errors | 0 | 0 |
| Truncated responses | 0 | 0 |
| Natural stops | 100% | 100% |

- No accuracy regression in this run. The one-question gap is noise (sampling and batching differ).
- Kernel test (`test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.py`, gfx950): both shapes at 1, 8, 2047, 2048, 2049 tokens vs a BF16 reference (rel L2 < 0.20, cosine > 0.98), CUDA graph replay with changed inputs, and input rejection.
- Runtime test (`test/registered/unit/models/test_kimi_k3_rocm_mxfp4.py`, CPU): fused/unfused selection, routing and shared outputs, threshold boundary, reload lifecycle, AITER opt-out.
- At the current head: 9 passed (5 GPU on MI355X, 4 CPU); `test/registered/unit/kernels/` 247 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Setup: 8x MI355X (gfx950), `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, TP8/DCP8, no MoE a2a, no speculative decoding. Both lanes use the same source, checkpoint, flags, and workload; only `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4` differs.
- Cookbook MI355X Balanced AITER/FP8-KV recipe, with these deviations: local Quark checkpoint, radix cache off (prefix-free traffic), 16K chunked prefill, 64K context, graph and request caps of 64 (not graph cap 256), `--mem-fraction-static 0.90` (not 0.85), `--mamba-full-memory-ratio 3.53`. Both servers resolve a memory fraction of 0.765.
- Workload: random 8192 input / 1024 output, range ratio 1, seed 42, temperature 0, ignore EOS, 4 warmup requests, cache flush. 2 reps of `2 x concurrency` requests per concurrency; all 328 requests per lane succeeded with 1024 output tokens; achieved concurrency within 1% of target.
- Values: median over the 2 reps of each run's mean latency and aggregate output throughput (all 8 GPUs, not per GPU).

| Concurrency | TTFT off/on (ms) | Change | TPOT off/on (ms) | Change | Output tok/s off/on | Change |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 820.32 / 772.75 | -5.8% | 20.01 / 19.97 | -0.2% | 96.18 / 96.56 | +0.4% |
| 16 | 4552.57 / 4241.00 | -6.8% | 29.72 / 29.51 | -0.7% | 468.57 / 475.81 | +1.5% |
| 64 | 15005.46 / 13965.27 | -6.9% | 53.96 / 52.97 | -1.8% | 933.30 / 961.47 | +3.0% |

- Memory caveat: at `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`, turning the flag on dropped `max_total_num_tokens` from 1,815,792 to 144,624. At concurrency 16 only about 15 8K requests fit, and output throughput fell from 470.93 to 365.99 tok/s. At 0.90 for both lanes, capacity is 8,882,768 (off) and 7,211,600 (on), and both sustain the target concurrency. This is not a speedup under a tight, unchanged KV budget.
- Profiler: the enabled prefill trace shows 368 `f4gemm_bf16_per1x32Fp4_BpreShuffle_256x256` launches on rank 0 attributed to `latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run`; the baseline shows none.
- Environment: Torch `2.11.0+rocm7.2`, Transformers `5.19.0`, FlyDSL `0.3.4`, AITER `2bb549102ba2d9e51da8ef21107361827075d8b6` with three local changes held fixed in both lanes (`pa_mqa_logits_fp4_prefill.py`, `csrc/cpp_itfs/torch_utils.py`, the gfx950 `mla_a8w8_qh64_qseqlen1_gqaratio64_nm.co` binary).

Launch (run with the flag at `0` and at `1`):

```bash
SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 \
SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4=0 \
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /data/models/Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --dcp-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \
  --prefill-attention-backend aiter --decode-attention-backend aiter \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dtype bfloat16 --mem-fraction-static 0.90 \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 --reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --tool-call-parser kimi_k3 \
  --disable-radix-cache --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --context-length 65536 \
  --max-running-requests 64 --mamba-full-memory-ratio 3.53
```

Benchmark (for `c` in 2, 16, 64, twice each):

```bash
python -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 \
  --random-range-ratio 1 --num-prompts "$((2 * c))" --max-concurrency "$c" \
  --seed 42 --temperature 0 --warmup-requests 4 --flush-cache
```

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+"""AITER gfx950 MXFP4 GEMMs for Kimi-K3 latent projections."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import torch
+
+_PRESHUFFLE_LAYOUT = (16, 16)
+_Ops = tuple[
+    Callable[..., tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]],
+    Callable[..., torch.Tensor],
+    Callable[..., torch.Tensor],
+    torch.dtype,
+]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _ops() -> _Ops | None:
+    try:
+        from aiter import QuantType, dtypes, gemm_a4w4
+        from aiter.ops.quant import get_hip_quant
+        from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+    except ImportError:
+        return None
+    return get_hip_quant(QuantType.per_1x32), shuffle_weight, gemm_a4w4, dtypes.fp4x2
+
+
+def supported(*, device: torch.device | None = None) -> bool:
+    if torch.version.hip is None or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return False
+    if device is not None and device.type != "cuda":
+        return False
+    arch = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+    return arch == "gfx950" and _ops() is not None
+
+
+def _require_ops(*, device: torch.device) -> _Ops:
+    if not supported(device=device):
+        raise RuntimeError("latent MXFP4 GEMM requires AITER on gfx950")
+    ops = _ops()
+    if ops is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("AITER MXFP4 GEMM operators are unavailable")
+    return ops
+
+
+def pack(*, weight: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Preshuffled MXFP4 weight and E8M0 scales for a BF16 [out, in] weight."""
+    # gemm_a4w4 and the preshuffled scales read whole 256x256 tiles.
+    if (
+        weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or weight.ndim != 2
+        or weight.shape[0] == 0
+        or weight.shape[0] % 256 != 0
+        or weight.shape[1] == 0
+        or weight.shape[1] % 256 != 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MXFP4 needs a nonempty 2D BF16 weight with output/input dimensions "
+            "aligned to 256, got "
+            f"{weight.dtype} {tuple(weight.shape)}"
+        )
+    quant, shuffle, _, fp4x2 = _require_ops(device=weight.device)
+    q, scale = quant(weight.contiguous(), quant_dtype=fp4x2, shuffle=True)

+"""Optional MXFP4 copies of Kimi-K3's replicated latent MoE projections."""
+
+import logging
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm import latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import print_warning_once
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def build_latent_mxfp4_projections() -> Optional["LatentMXFP4Projections"]:
+    """Per-layer holder when the device can run the MXFP4 GEMMs, else None."""
+    if not (envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.get() and latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.supported()):
+        print_warning_once(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4 needs SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 and AITER "
+            "on gfx950; keeping the BF16 latent projections."
+        )
+        return None
+    return LatentMXFP4Projections(
+        min_tokens=envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4_MIN_TOKENS.get()
+    )
+
+
+class LatentMXFP4Projections(nn.Module):
+    down_weight: torch.Tensor | None
+    down_scale: torch.Tensor | None
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor | None
+    up_scale: torch.Tensor | None
+
+    def __init__(self, *, min_tokens: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        if min_tokens < 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_LATENT_MXFP4_MIN_TOKENS must be positive, "
+                f"got {min_tokens}"
+            )
+        self.min_tokens = min_tokens
+        self.register_buffer("down_weight", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("down_scale", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("up_weight", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("up_scale", None, persistent=False)
+
+    def prepare(self, *, down_weight: torch.Tensor, up_weight: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        if (
+            down_weight.shape != (3584, 7168)
+            or up_weight.shape != (7168, 3584)
+            or down_weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or up_weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or down_weight.device != up_weight.device
+            or not latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.supported(device=down_weight.device)
+        ):
+            self.down_weight = self.down_scale = self.up_weight = self.up_scale = None
+            logger.warning(
+                "Kimi-K3 latent MXFP4 is unavailable for these weights/device; "
+                "keeping the original latent projections"
+            )
+            return
+        down, down_scale = latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.pack(weight=down_weight)
+        up, up_scale = latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.pack(weight=up_weight)
+        if self.down_weight is None:
+            self.down_weight, self.down_scale = down, down_scale
+            self.up_weight, self.up_scale = up, up_scale
+            return
+        # A reload (e.g. a weight update) refills the copies in place: captured
+        # CUDA graphs hold their addresses.
+        for dst, src in (
+            (self.down_weight, down),
+            (self.down_scale, down_scale),
+            (self.up_weight, up),
+            (self.up_scale, up_scale),
+        ):
+            dst.copy_(src)
+
+    def can_run(self, *, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return self.down_weight is not None and num_tokens >= self.min_tokens
+
+    def down(self, *, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.down_weight is None or self.down_scale is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("latent MXFP4 down projection has not been prepared")
+        return latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(
+            x=x, weight=self.down_weight, scale=self.down_scale
+        )
+
+    def up(self, *, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.up_weight is None or self.up_scale is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("latent MXFP4 up projection has not been prepared")
+        return latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(
+            x=x, weight=self.up_weight, scale=self.up_scale
+        )

+"""Numerical and graph-replay tests for Kimi-K3 latent MXFP4 GEMMs."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm import latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=120, stage="stage-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "no GPU")
+class TestKimiK3LatentMXFP4(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        if not latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.supported():
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("Kimi-K3 latent MXFP4 needs AITER on gfx950")
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        cls.device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        cls.projections = []
+        for out_features, in_features in ((3584, 7168), (7168, 3584)):
+            weight = (
+                torch.randn(
+                    out_features, in_features, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=cls.device
+                )
+                * 0.02
+            )
+            packed, scale = latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.pack(weight=weight)
+            cls.projections.append((weight, packed, scale))
+
+    def _assert_matches_bf16(self, *, actual, x, weight):
+        self.assertEqual(actual.shape, (x.shape[0], weight.shape[0]))
+        self.assertEqual(actual.dtype, x.dtype)
+        expected = torch.nn.functional.linear(x, weight)
+        rel_l2 = (
+            (actual.float() - expected.float()).norm() / expected.float().norm()
+        ).item()
+        cosine = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+            actual.float().flatten(), expected.float().flatten(), dim=0
+        ).item()
+        # MXFP4 rounding is lossy; these bounds detect layout/scale corruption.
+        self.assertLess(rel_l2, 0.20)
+        self.assertGreater(cosine, 0.98)
+
+    def test_run_matches_bf16_reference(self):
+        for weight, packed, scale in self.projections:
+            for tokens in (1, 8, 2047, 2048, 2049):
+                with self.subTest(shape=tuple(weight.shape), tokens=tokens):
+                    x = (
+                        torch.randn(
+                            tokens,
+                            weight.shape[1],
+                            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                            device=self.device,
+                        )
+                        * 0.1
+                    )
+                    actual = latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(x=x, weight=packed, scale=scale)
+                    self._assert_matches_bf16(actual=actual, x=x, weight=weight)
+
+    def test_graph_replay_uses_changed_inputs(self):
+        for weight, packed, scale in self.projections:
+            with self.subTest(shape=tuple(weight.shape)):
+                x = (
+                    torch.randn(
+                        8, weight.shape[1], dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device
+                    )
+                    * 0.1
+                )
+                latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(x=x, weight=packed, scale=scale)
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                    out = latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(x=x, weight=packed, scale=scale)
+                graph.replay()
+                first = out.clone()
+                x.copy_(torch.randn_like(x) * 0.1)
+                graph.replay()
+                self.assertFalse(torch.equal(first, out))
+                self._assert_matches_bf16(actual=out, x=x, weight=weight)
+
+    def test_rejects_invalid_weight_layout(self):
+        # gemm_a4w4 and the preshuffled scales read whole 256x256 tiles.
+        for shape in ((7168,), (16, 64), (3600, 7168), (3584, 7200), (256, 0)):
+            with self.subTest(shape=shape):
+                weight = torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device)
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "aligned to 256"):
+                    latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.pack(weight=weight)
+
+    def test_rejects_incompatible_activations(self):
+        _, packed, scale = self.projections[0]
+        for shape, dtype in (
+            ((8, 7168), torch.float16),
+            ((8, 3584), torch.bfloat16),
+            ((8, 1, 7168), torch.bfloat16),
+            ((0, 7168), torch.bfloat16),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(shape=shape, dtype=dtype):
+                x = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, device=self.device)
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(x=x, weight=packed, scale=scale)
+
+    def test_rejects_missing_or_host_scales(self):
+        _, packed, scale = self.projections[0]
+        x = torch.ones((1, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device)
+        for invalid_scale in (scale.cpu(), scale.flatten()[:0]):
+            with self.subTest(device=invalid_scale.device, size=invalid_scale.numel()):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "scales must match"):
+                    latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip.run(x=x, weight=packed, scale=invalid_scale)
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+import unittest

+
+class _Linear(nn.Linear):
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return F.linear(x, self.weight), None
+
+
+class _TopK(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, x, logits):
+        return logits
+
+
+class _Experts(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, x, logits):
+        return x * logits.sigmoid()
+
+
+class _Shared(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)
+        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)
+        self.act_fn = nn.Identity()
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return self.down_proj(self.gate_up_proj(x))
+
+
+def _moe(*, prepared: bool | None):
+    moe = kimi_k3.KimiK3MoE.__new__(kimi_k3.KimiK3MoE)
+    nn.Module.__init__(moe)
+    moe.use_latent_moe = True
+    moe.moe_hidden_size = 2
+    moe.tp_size = 1
+    moe.alt_stream = None
+    moe.fuse_ar_norm = False
+    moe._sbo_shared_overlap = False
+    moe._shared_experts_tp_comm = False
+    moe._use_mega_moe = False
+    moe._ep_front_eligible = False
+    moe._routed_needs_reduce = False
+    moe._front_fp32 = False
+    moe._moe_front_needs_dense_bf16 = True
+    moe._route_quant_fuse_eligible = False
+    moe.gate = nn.Linear(4, 1, bias=False)
+    moe.routed_expert_down_proj = _Linear(4, 2, bias=False)
+    moe.routed_expert_up_proj = _Linear(2, 4, bias=False)
+    moe.routed_expert_norm = nn.Identity()
+    moe.shared_experts = _Shared()
+    moe.experts = _Experts()
+    moe.topk = _TopK()
+    moe._front_sizes = [4, 1, 2]
+    moe._front_w = torch.cat(
+        [
+            moe.shared_experts.gate_up_proj.weight,
+            moe.gate.weight,
+            moe.routed_expert_down_proj.weight,
+        ]
+    ).detach()
+    if prepared is None:
+        moe._latent_mxfp4 = None
+        return moe
+    moe._latent_mxfp4 = LatentMXFP4Projections(min_tokens=2)
+    if prepared:
+        moe._latent_mxfp4.down_weight = moe.routed_expert_down_proj.weight.detach() * 2
+        moe._latent_mxfp4.up_weight = moe.routed_expert_up_proj.weight.detach() * 3
+        moe._latent_mxfp4.down_scale = torch.ones(1)
+        moe._latent_mxfp4.up_scale = torch.ones(1)
+    return moe

+        self.assertFalse(projections.can_run(num_tokens=2048))
+        down = torch.empty((3584, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+        up = torch.empty((7168, 3584), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip, "supported", return_value=True),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip,
+                "pack",
+                side_effect=[
+                    (torch.ones(1), torch.ones(1)),
+                    (torch.ones(1), torch.ones(1)),
+                    (torch.full((1,), 2.0), torch.ones(1)),
+                    (torch.full((1,), 3.0), torch.ones(1)),
+                ],
+            ),
+        ):
+            projections.prepare(down_weight=down, up_weight=up)
+            # A reload refills the copies captured CUDA graphs already point at.
+            buffers = (projections.down_weight, projections.up_weight)
+            projections.prepare(down_weight=down, up_weight=up)
+        self.assertIs(projections.down_weight, buffers[0])
+        self.assertIs(projections.up_weight, buffers[1])
+        self.assertEqual(projections.down_weight.item(), 2.0)
+        self.assertEqual(projections.up_weight.item(), 3.0)
+        self.assertFalse(projections.can_run(num_tokens=2047))
+        self.assertTrue(projections.can_run(num_tokens=2048))
+        self.assertTrue(projections.can_run(num_tokens=2049))
+        self.assertEqual(dict(projections.state_dict()), {})
+        with self.assertLogs("sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3_rocm_mxfp4", level="WARNING"):
+            projections.prepare(down_weight=down.to(torch.float16), up_weight=up)
+        self.assertFalse(projections.can_run(num_tokens=2048))
+        self.assertIsNone(projections.up_weight)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "has not been prepared"):
+            projections.up(x=torch.ones(1, 3584))
+
+    def test_builder_honors_the_aiter_opt_out(self):
+        """SGLANG_USE_AITER=0 must keep the BF16 latent projections even though
+        AITER is importable on the device."""
+        with mock.patch.object(latent_mxfp4_aiter_hip, "supported", return_value=True):
+            with envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(False):
+                self.assertIsNone(build_latent_mxfp4_projections())
+            with envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(True):
+                self.assertIsNotNone(build_latent_mxfp4_projections())
+
+    def test_rejects_nonpositive_token_floor(self):
+        for min_tokens in (0, -1):
+            with self.subTest(min_tokens=min_tokens):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "must be positive"):
+                    LatentMXFP4Projections(min_tokens=min_tokens)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
